main.description: Returns recent activity for the authenticated tracked viewer as flat items without grouping or related-activity attachment. Uses the same pagination, filtering, and hydration as getActivity.

feed.description: Reverse-chronological activity items. No groups or relatedActivity children are emitted.

associatedRecords.description: A map of AT URI to locally resolved associated record.

actors.description: A map of actor DID to app.bsky.actor.defs#profileViewBasic.
